what: S31: HD rate-distortion on the N6. Quality is the encoder's own hardware MSE readback, converted to PSNR. Same scene, same run, 90 frames each.
board: OpenMV N6 on nereus002, firmware OpenMV v5.0.0-58.ga83bc776f5 (PR #3247 + denoise patch)

results.error: H264 encoder error -3 (INVALID_ARGUMENT) -- level 4.1 caps the bitrate near 50 Mbps, so rate-controlled H.264 cannot be asked to spend MJPEG-q90 bytes at all

denoise_probe: codec.H264Encoder(denoise=N) raises 'this silicon reports no denoise filter' for every N>0. H264EncApi.c:527 gates noiseReductionEnable on hwCfg.dnfSupport, and the N6's VC8000 reports 0. The in-loop Wiener denoiser is NOT available on this chip.
